svg.aria-label: Cartoon sloth in a hard hat operating a yellow tracked excavator on a sunny construction site
svg.title: Sleepytime Dig — a sloth excavator operator
svg.desc: A cartoon sloth wearing a yellow hard hat and an orange high-visibility vest sits in the cab of a yellow tracked excavator, calmly steering while the boom, stick and toothed bucket dig into a dirt pile. Sun, clouds, birds, cones, a caution-striped barricade and exhaust puffs complete the sunny construction site.
